# QYL0108: Non-interceptable [Traced]

<!-- <auto-generated /> This file is generated by tools/Qyl.OpenTelemetry.SemanticConventions.Analyzers.DocsGenerator. -->

| Analyzer | `Qyl0108NonInterceptableTracedAnalyzer` |
| Enabled by default | Yes |

## Description

The [Traced] attribute triggers compile-time interception to create spans. Abstract, extern, and partial definition methods cannot be intercepted by the source generator, so [Traced] will be silently ignored.
